clue.text: Bowler's appeal: first wicket! (I've forgotten the name)

indicators.note: first here means take only the opening letter of wicket

parts.note: a bowler is a hat, so bowler's reads as hat's
IT is sex appeal, as in having 'it'

explanation.surface: A cricket bowler shouts an appeal as the first wicket falls, then forgets the batsman's name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bowler' looks like cricket but is the hat; IT for appeal is a crossword staple (she's got 'it').
explanation.definitionFit: A whatsit is a placeholder word used when a speaker cannot recall what something is called.

clue.text: Shouts of triumph? I made a mistake

definitions.meaning: first meaning: loud cries of joy
second meaning: the exclamation said after a blunder

explanation.walkthrough: The same letters are the plural noun of joyful cries and the interjection of someone who has slipped up.
explanation.definitionFit: The interjection is uttered on noticing a blunder, while the plural noun means loud, excited cries of celebration.

clue.text: A master of wine avoiding church counter

indicators.note: avoiding means the named letters are kept out of the god's name

parts.note: Bacchus is the Roman god of wine

explanation.surface: A Master of Wine skips church to count bottles, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Master of wine' suggests the MW qualification, but it is the god of wine.
explanation.definitionFit: An abacus is a frame of beads used to count and calculate, so it is literally a counting device.

clue.text: Explorer's hut revealed a secret

parts.note: a shack is a crude hut
to let on is to reveal a secret

explanation.surface: An explorer's base hut gives away something hidden.
explanation.walkthrough: Ernest Shackleton was the Antarctic explorer whose expedition huts still stand.
explanation.definitionFit: Ernest Shackleton led famous Antarctic expeditions in the early twentieth century.

clue.text: Gimme short recording

indicators.note: short means the word is cut off before its final letter

parts.note: a taping is a recording

explanation.surface: Someone demands a brief recording be handed over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gimme' reads as 'give me', but it is the golfing term.
explanation.definitionFit: In golf a gimme is a putt so close that it is conceded, the same as a short easy putt into the hole.

clue.text: Balance for one second on large animal

indicators.note: on means the following pieces come after the animal

parts.note: a seal is a sizeable marine mammal
EG, for example, is what 'for one' means

explanation.surface: Someone balances on a big animal for a single second.
explanation.definitionFit: Sea legs are the ability to keep steady on a moving ship, so they give balance aboard.

clue.text: Some birds go with empty robins' nests for a change

indicators.note: for a change signals that the letters get rearranged
empty means take only the outside letters of robins', dropping its contents

explanation.surface: Birds go off to robins' empty nests for a change of scene.
explanation.definitionFit: Songsters are songbirds, a term for birds noted for their singing.

clue.text: Lily heading off from old rotten borough

indicators.note: heading off means the first letter is removed

parts.note: Old Sarum was the most notorious rotten borough, a parliamentary seat with hardly any voters

explanation.surface: A lily is cut from an old corrupt borough.
explanation.walkthrough: A rotten borough was an English constituency with almost no electors before the 1832 Reform Act; Old Sarum, near Salisbury, is the classic one.
explanation.definitionFit: The arum is a plant often called the arum lily, with a hooded white spathe.

clue.text: Heavenly round these parts and others

indicators.note: round means the Latin abbreviation surrounds the other piece

parts.note: et al. is Latin shorthand for 'and others'
here means in these parts

explanation.surface: A heavenly circuit around these parts and further afield.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal describes something airy and celestial, as of the upper heavens.

clue.text: Nods, X-ray turning out a gem

indicators.note: turning out signals the letters of the fodder are reshaped into something new

explanation.surface: Someone nods as an X-ray reveals a hidden jewel.
explanation.definitionFit: Sardonyx is a variety of onyx with bands of sard, used as a gemstone.

clue.text: Head of state's love a Shakespearean queen rejected

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, O

indicators.note: rejected means turned back, so the pair is read in reverse

parts.note: Queen Mab is the fairy described by Mercutio in Romeo and Juliet

explanation.surface: A head of state's love spurns a queen from Shakespeare.
explanation.definitionFit: Barack Obama served as US president, the American head of state.

clue.text: Clerk's enclosure to woman covering matter

indicators.note: covering here means the woman sits beside and over the matter, so her letters follow it

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure for animals
pus is matter from a wound
HER is a pronoun for a woman

explanation.surface: A clerk sends an enclosure to a woman along with a matter of business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Matter' looks like a business matter but is the medical sense: pus.
explanation.definitionFit: A pen-pusher is a disparaging term for an office worker doing routine paperwork.

clue.text: Daring Nazis are after fortune hidden in tree

indicators.note: are after means the Nazi letters come at the end
hidden in means the word for fortune is tucked inside the tree

parts.note: a pine is a tree
luck is fortune
the SS was the Nazi paramilitary force

explanation.surface: Bold Nazis hunt for a fortune buried in a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Pluckiness is courage or spirit, the noun for showing pluck and nerve.

clue.text: As country-lover, Pat protects this small group

indicators.note: Pat protects this means the name wraps around the answer, so removing it from the country-lover leaves the answer

parts.note: a patriot loves their country
taken as the name written

explanation.surface: Pat, a patriot, shields a little band.
explanation.walkthrough: The word for a country-lover is Pat's letters around the answer, so take Pat away to find it.
explanation.definitionFit: A trio is a set of three, such as three musicians playing together.

clue.text: Speed up meal cooked and eaten by Aussie

indicators.note: eaten by means the jumbled meal goes inside the Aussie word

parts.note: Strine is Australian English, a comic rendering of how Australians say 'Australian'

indicators.note: cooked signals the letters of meal are mixed up

explanation.surface: An Australian wolfs a cooked meal to save time.
explanation.definitionFit: To streamline is to make a process more efficient and quicker, as shaping things for less drag.

clue.text: Pirate, 90, suffering a long time in here?

indicators.note: suffering signals the letters are put through it and come out mangled

parts.note: 90 written in words is ninety

explanation.surface: A ninety-year-old pirate suffering a lengthy stay somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is by example: a long sentence is served in a prison.
explanation.definitionFit: A penitentiary is a prison, a place where someone may serve a long sentence.

clue.text: Promote development of giant site

indicators.note: development of signals the letters are built into a new form

explanation.surface: Someone champions building on a huge site.
explanation.definitionFit: To instigate is to bring about or initiate an action, to foster it into being.

clue.text: Apply to a prince for a chaplain

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for
CH is an abbreviation for chaplain

explanation.surface: Someone petitions a prince to appoint a chaplain.
explanation.definitionFit: To approach someone is to make a request or proposal to them, as when one applies.

clue.text: The way to hold garden tool to deal with this?

definitions.text: The way to hold garden tool to deal with this?

indicators.note: to hold means the way word encloses the tool

parts.note: how means the way something is done
an edger is a tool for trimming lawn edges and borders

explanation.surface: Advice on how to grip a garden tool for tidying something.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes the answer: a garden tool is what you use to keep it trim.
explanation.definitionFit: A hedgerow is a row of shrubs forming a boundary, which a gardener trims with a tool.

clue.text: Fascinated by second hand

definitions.meaning: first meaning: preoccupied, held in thrall

explanation.walkthrough: Split as PRE-POSSESSED, the word means previously owned, which is what second-hand goods are.
explanation.definitionFit: Prepossessed means preoccupied or captivated, and broken into its parts it means already owned before.

clue.text: Informally intend to secure a monitor

indicators.note: to secure means the slang word grips the letter inside it

parts.note: gonna is a slangy way of saying 'going to', intend

explanation.surface: Someone casually plans to obtain a computer screen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Monitor' suggests a screen, but it is the lizard.
explanation.definitionFit: A goanna is an Australian monitor lizard, a large reptile of that family.

clue.text: Lyric outside lifted little room

indicators.note: outside means the song goes around the other piece

parts.note: a lay is a song or lyric poem

indicators.note: lifted in a down clue means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: wee is Scottish for little

explanation.surface: A song outside raises the spirits of a small room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Little room' looks like the definition; 'little' gives the inner piece, leaving 'room' alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Leeway is room for manoeuvre, a margin of freedom to act.

clue.text: Two US states that share a capital

parts.note: the two US states are Rhode Island and Georgia; this piece is RI, the postal code for Rhode Island
the second of the pair, GA, the postal code for Georgia

explanation.surface: Two American states share one capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Riga is the capital city of Latvia on the Baltic coast.

clue.text: Woman's convenience, or inconvenience

parts.note: Di's, belonging to Di, a woman's name
a commode is a chair with a chamber pot, a convenience

explanation.surface: The ladies' convenience is, or isn't, convenient.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Convenience' in British English is a toilet, as in public conveniences.
explanation.definitionFit: To discommode is a formal verb meaning to cause trouble or bother to someone.

clue.text: Despicable person picking up last bit of pancake

indicators.note: picking up last bit of means the final letter is lifted higher, earlier in the word in a down clue

parts.note: a crepe is a thin pancake

explanation.surface: A nasty person grabs the last scrap of a pancake.
explanation.definitionFit: A creep is an unpleasant, obsequious or sinister individual.

clue.text: Actual existence in county (vote denied)

indicators.note: denied means the voting mark is taken away

parts.note: Essex is an English county
X is the mark made on a ballot paper

explanation.surface: A county is refused the vote, yet it still exists.
explanation.definitionFit: Esse is the philosophical Latin term for being, real existence.

clue.text: Love to break quickly into a modern industry

indicators.note: to break means the god of love bursts in
into means the love god goes inside the word for quickly

parts.note: apace means quickly
Eros is the god of love

explanation.surface: Love hurries into a new-fangled industry.
explanation.definitionFit: Aerospace covers aviation and spaceflight manufacturing, a high-tech sector of the twentieth century onward.

clue.text: A good idea's occurred to me — say yes? No!

definitions.text: A good idea's occurred to me

indicators.note: say signals that the words are heard rather than written

parts.note: aye is yes, and no is as written: said together they run AYE NO

explanation.surface: Someone has a brainwave and contradicts themselves: yes, no!
explanation.definitionFit: The exclamation is what one says on suddenly having a bright idea or inspiration.

clue.text: At hotel wonder about vital delivery tracking system

parts.note: H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: about means the wonder word surrounds the other piece

parts.note: awe is wonder
key means vital, essential

explanation.surface: At a hotel, someone marvels at an essential parcel-tracking system.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Delivery' suggests parcels, but it is a cricket or tennis ball delivery; Hawk-Eye tracks the ball for umpiring decisions.
explanation.definitionFit: Hawk-Eye is the computer ball-tracking technology used to adjudicate line calls and lbw in sport.

clue.text: Rescheduled November replay that all can attend

indicators.note: rescheduled means rearranged, so the letters are put in a new order

parts.note: N is November in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A replay is moved to November so every fan can come.
explanation.definitionFit: A plenary session is one attended by every member of a conference or assembly.
